QF.id: AIFM CIII Governance and Due Diligence_29

question.text: Managers of AIFs/VCFs classified as 'Self-certification REs' under CSCRF are exempt from the mandatory Market-SOC (M-SOC) requirement if their client base is:

explanation.text: The Logic: Managers of AIFs/VCFs classified as Self-certification REs and with a client base of less than 100 are exempted from the mandatory Market-SOC (M-SOC) requirement under CSCRF. The Trap: "More than 1,000", "Exactly 500" and "no exemption threshold" misstate the prescribed less-than-100 client-base carve-out. Note: The exemption is conditional on both the Self-certification RE classification and the client-base threshold being satisfied.
